zh: 社区主题、语言包和插件的目录、预览及下载在 GitHub 连接失败、限流或服务异常时会自动切换到 GHFast 镜像。
启用封面取色后，连续切换游戏时背景颜色过渡更平滑，封面尚未加载时会保留当前色调。
减少切换机种时重复读取游戏库，改善游戏较多时的切换响应。
en: Community theme, language pack, and plugin catalogs, previews, and downloads automatically switch to the GHFast mirror if GitHub is unreachable, rate-limited, or experiencing a service error.
When cover-based colors are enabled, backgrounds transition more smoothly as you browse games and keep their current color while the next cover loads.
Switching platforms reads the game library less often, improving responsiveness in large libraries.
